name: io.github.tonyyang0504/swag_pro_printfection-mcp
description: Swag Pro (formerly Printfection) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SWAG_PRO_PRINTFECTION_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Swag Pro (Printfection) API key from https://app.printfection.com/account/api_keys.php, sent as the HTTP Basic username with an empty password.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SWAG_PRO_PRINTFECTION_CAMPAIGN_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric id of the Collection campaign create_order places orders in (GET /campaigns, not mapped). Only Giveaway and Collection campaigns are supported by the API.
